description: Search postgres commits (code-history index), newest first, like git log: range (a rev = its first-parent line, A..B, or all; default all = every branch (master, REL_*, and three dead pre-2005 branches), each commit once with branches = the branches its change landed on, ordered by commit date), message (regex, case-insensitive), author (regex over author, committer and Author/Co-authored-by/Reviewed-by trailers), paths, since/until (YYYY-MM-DD), changed_lines (a regex an added or removed line matches, as git log -G) and occurrences (a string whose count in a file changed, as git log -S). complete=false when changed_lines/occurrences matched more lines than it reads (300,000): commits may be missing.

author.description: Regex over author, committer and credit trailers

changed_lines.description: Regex an added or removed line matches (git log -G)

occurrences.description: String whose number of occurrences changed (git log -S)

range.description: A rev (its line back to the root), A..B, or all; default all (every branch)

name: search_commits
